# @aai-agency/og-components

> Production-grade O&G React components, agent-first. Maps, charts, detail cards, selection panels, overlay management, validation schemas, and data persistence. Free, open source, MIT. By AAI Agency.

## Install

```
pnpm add @aai-agency/og-components mapbox-gl
```

Requires: React 18+, Tailwind CSS 4+, mapbox-gl 3+, Mapbox access token

## Setup

```css
@import "@aai-agency/og-components/styles.css";
```

```ts
import "mapbox-gl/dist/mapbox-gl.css";
```

## Components

- Map — Interactive asset map with deck.gl, clustering, overlays, drawing tools, lasso selection
- Chart — The canonical single-panel chart. Choose `kind="line"` or `kind="bar"`. Per-series label/color/axis, functional X/Y value formatting, and configurable axis/tooltip/legend/title typography sizes and weights are supported. Forecasts supplied as data are ordinary TimeSeries entries with `seriesType: "forecast"`; `forecast={{ seriesId, ... }}` is the optional interactive line-chart editor adapter.
- ChartGroup — Composes ordered line/bar panels over an ID-addressable registry that preserves native timestamps. Each panel selects or derives series by explicit IDs. Visible X controls mirror one shared XState window; Y controls stay local to each panel and axis. Per-chart settings can hide X/Y bars or zoom buttons, independently enable a larger presentation treatment, and apply a layout everywhere. Presentation mode temporarily suppresses chrome without overwriting visibility preferences. Bar buckets drill the shared window across monthly, daily, hourly, or secondly panels. Cross-resolution derivations require explicit resampling and aggregation.
- EventTimeline — Well events/history component. Default `orientation="vertical"` renders a clean, light history list (shadcn/Notion style) grouped by period: a muted date column, a color-coded status dot, the title with a soft type tag, spans with duration + range, a group filter (`showFilters`), and a click-to-open detail dialog (an accessible modal like a filled-out form: name, date, tags, description, details, and `attachments` with inline previews for images / file cards for others). `orientation="horizontal"` renders a compact time-aligned lane (with swim-lanes via per-event `lane`) that lines up beneath a chart when given a `domain` matching its visible X window and `padding` matching its plot inset
- LineChart and ProductionChart — Deprecated compatibility entries; migrate to Chart with `kind="line"`
- DeclineCurve — Deprecated. Use Chart with a `forecast` config; kept as an alias of the same engine
- AssetDetailCard — Expandable detail panel for any asset, auto-generates sections
- SelectionPanel — Multi-select panel with filter chips and summary stats
- OverlayManager — Upload and style KMZ/KML/GeoJSON/Shapefile overlays
- MapControls — Toolbar with pan, zoom, fullscreen, center, draw, layer controls
- Tooltip — Radix-based tooltip (shadcn pattern)

## Data Model

Every entity is an Asset:

```ts
{ id, name, type, status, coordinates: { lat, lng }, properties: {} }
```

## Subpath Exports

- @aai-agency/og-components — Components and types
- @aai-agency/og-components/schemas — Zod validation schemas
- @aai-agency/og-components/utils — Data helpers (formatting, geo, CSV)
- @aai-agency/og-components/services — Storage backends (localStorage, SQLite, in-memory)
- @aai-agency/og-components/chart — focused chart component and pure preparation services
- @aai-agency/og-components/event-timeline — events/history timeline component and pure layout services
- @aai-agency/og-components/map — focused map components
- @aai-agency/og-components/types — shared domain types
- @aai-agency/og-components/ui — shared UI providers/primitives
- @aai-agency/og-components/machines — XState line-chart and map state machines
- @aai-agency/og-components/styles.css — Tailwind theme tokens
